parameters.help_en: The log ID, which is an MD5 hash generated by Cloud Threat Detection and Response (CTDR) based on specific parameters. You can call ListDataSourceLogs (https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854&activeTabKey=api|ListDataSourceLogs) to obtain the log ID
parameters.help_zh: 日志ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。可调用ListDataSourceLogs (https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854&activeTabKey=api|ListDataSourceLogs)获取日志ID
parameters.name: log_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The data source ID, which is an MD5 hash generated by CTDR based on specific parameters. parameters.help_en:
The code of the cloud service provider. Valid values:
qcloud: Tencent Cloud.
aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.
hcloud: Huawei Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
多云的code。取值：
qcloud：腾讯云。
aliyun：阿里云。
hcloud：华为云
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the CTDR data management center is located. Specify the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: The assets belong to the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
ap-southeast-1: The assets belong to regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

Count.description_en: The number of logs deleted. A value of 1 indicates success. A value less than or equal to 0 indicates failure
Count.description_zh: 删除的日志的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败
